source.name: Football Shirt Culture: Ghana 2026 Puma Home Kit
source.note: Kit maker. Named-press kit write-up: the shirt carries the Black Star centrally between the Puma logo and the Ghana Football Association crest, plain white sleeves, a plain white rear with a small Ghana flag below the back collar, and matching white shorts; no commercial sponsor on any placement.
source.quote: Puma has unveiled the Ghana 2026 Home kit, which will be worn by the Ghana national football team during the 2026-2027 international cycle, including 2026 FIFA World Cup fixtures.

summary: Puma home kit for the 2026 World Cup cycle. No commercial shirt sponsors: Football Shirt Culture's launch write-up describes only the GFA crest, the central Black Star and Puma branding on the shirt, plain sleeves and rear, with matching white shorts.
